name: toolu-cli
description: Source of the @toolu/plugins CLI. Publishes from npm/, never from here: a workspace named @toolu/plugins would shadow the registry for npx.

scripts.build: mkdir -p npm/assets npm/dist && cp ../../.claude-plugin/marketplace.json npm/assets/marketplace.json && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=npm/dist/cli.js && chmod 755 npm/dist/cli.js
